title: Common Definitions
description: Shared primitives for the bridge contracts (spec 4.3, 8.2). Enum values use the Kotlin constant names in bridge/contracts so default serialization round-trips; operation and transport names use the lowercase wire names from spec 7 and Appendix A.

ContractVersion.description: '<major>.<minor>'. This schema set is major version 1; a breaking change requires a new major version and a new schema set (RTB-13).

RequestId.description: Globally unique per request (RTB-42). Appendix A shows the form 'urn:uuid:<uuid>'. Stable across retries of the same logical request so the phone can deduplicate.

Timestamp.description: RFC 3339 UTC timestamp with a 'Z' suffix. The Kotlin core uses epoch milliseconds internally; adapters convert at the boundary.

Principal.description: Canonical principal produced by a transport adapter after it authenticates its own credential. Never carries credential material.

GitSha.description: Full 40-character lowercase hex Git object id.

RepositoryFullName.description: 'owner/name'. Normalized to lowercase before allow-list lookup; only the current canonical name is accepted (renames are not automatically followed). Resolved against the approved-repository record; never used as a URL fragment (spec 7).

BranchName.description: Branch name following git-check-ref-format, without the 'refs/heads/' prefix.

GitRef.description: Branch, tag or commit SHA as supplied by the caller. Resolved by the phone.

RepoPath.description: Repository-relative path as received on the wire. This schema only rejects empty, oversized and control-character input. It deliberately does not reject dot segments, '..', percent sequences, backslashes or symlinks: those are decided by the canonical normalizer (RTB-49), which also resolves containment. Passing this schema is necessary, never sufficient.
